description: This file contains unit tests for shared channel functionality, including sharing, unsharing, and mention transformation logic within the Mattermost project.

classes.name: SelfReferentialSyncHandler
classes.description: A helper class for handling self-referential sync requests during testing of remote unsharing scenarios.

methods.name: setupSharedChannels
methods.description: Initializes shared channel settings for testing.

methods.name: TestApp_CheckCanInviteToSharedChannel
methods.description: Unit tests for checking if channels can be invited to shared channels, including sharing, unsharing, and permission checks.

methods.name: TestApp_RemoteUnsharing
methods.description: Tests the process of unsharing a channel remotely and the resulting system behavior, including system message posting.

methods.name: TestSyncMessageErrChannelNotSharedResponse
methods.description: Simulates receiving an error response indicating a channel is no longer shared and verifies proper handling.

methods.name: TestTransformMentionsOnReceive
methods.description: Unit tests for the logic transforming mention strings on message receipt, including various mention scenarios and edge cases.
